negative_case.tested_scope: Read-only boolean source predicate and real published queue/action fields; not an HMAC acceptance assertion.

finding: Financial-only source authorization is not sufficient for a forward migration of a live operating queue: a financially clock-valid ticket can be requested later than the first pending event. Any future queue migrator must cryptographically bind the old signed STATE, its original queue/cursor/clock and native prefix, and prohibit authorization that advances the native clock beyond due old work. This is an additional acceptance guard, not an observed exploit; the existing source guard still correctly refuses the old STATE.

required_implementation_regression.test_case: Restore genuine same-owned-account legacy engine at 3 processed events, next pending acceptance t=3, and 9 native actions. Demand an explicit migration request at t=4 with identical financial state and historical verifier. Reject before any source transition or financial mutation; preserve original keys and pending event. Separately allow only explicitly approved same-clock transition at t=2 with old signed envelope pinned, then process acceptance/clearing once on that same account with crash-and-retry, audit all obligations and deny replay/downgrade/fork.
verify_invariants: transition time does not pass earliest pending native event
old STATE HMAC validated under retained authority
no old event skipped, synthesized or reordered
immutable native prefix including source transition
only one final state transition under exclusive writer lock
restored continuation retains exact old account and liabilities
funding uses only audited available earned funds
claim before maturity at shared boundary
required_implementation_regression.do_not: Do not insert an unauthenticated clock clamp, edit STATE.json, reinterpret native days, re-sign old state without a traceable source transition or weaken source guards.
